title: chargehand conversation, v1
description: An agent a person can message and approve while it works: the body of GET /v1/conversations/{id} and of the 201 that starts one. Its events are conversation-event/v1 on /v1/conversations/{id}/events.

state.description: idle: no turn runs, a message starts one. running: a turn runs, a message waits in the queue. ended, lost and failed are final: lost means the server restarted while it was open.

runtime.description: The runtime that runs the agent, as the start request named it.

actor.description: The account that started it (ADR 0050); absent for one started from the CLI.

updated_at.description: The time of the latest event.

messages.description: Messages the person sent that reached the agent.

queued.description: Messages that wait for the running turn to end.

pending_approvals.description: Call ids the agent waits on; answer each at POST /v1/conversations/{id}/approvals/{call}.

usage.description: Absent until the agent has reported usage.

usd.description: Absent when the agent reports no dollars.

caps.description: The limits on this conversation. The account's own caps (ADR 0050) apply besides, and refuse a message with 429.

last_event_id.description: The id of the latest event: read the stream after it to see what happens next.

ended_reason.description: Set once the conversation is over.
